lead_headline: Restaurant tracker adds zero Friday leads; no foreclosures over $4M; liquor licensing goes dark for second straight day

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads Friday — quiet close caps week with no overnight additions. Active pipeline holds at 171 opening leads, 161 closures/temp closures (332 total).

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Friday — second consecutive blank day ends week with complete application freeze after Wednesday's 267-filing anomaly burst. No status changes detected. Week totals 266 new applications vs. 10 prior week—26.6x surge concentrated in single-day Wednesday spike suggests batch processing event or data correction flush. Pipeline returns to dormancy after extraordinary midweek volume, leaving unanswered whether spike represents backlog clearance or system artifact.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Friday — citation drought extends to 10 consecutive days with no pickups, establishing new record blackout period. Zero sources active. YTD remains frozen at 1,167 mentions (111 sources) with no movement since late July. Past 30 days: 128 mentions (4.3/day) makes current void 100% below norm vs. typical 60-80 weekly baseline. Ten-day freeze surpasses any prior weekend/holiday lull—points to sustained monitoring pipeline disruption or syndication outage beyond standard news cycle variance.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +6 Thursday (10 new, 4 canceled) — strongest single-day acquisition in two weeks breaks recent stagnation pattern. MTD improves to −12 (−0.9/day) from yesterday's −18, while 90-day net climbs to +75. Past week rebounds to +4 net (21 new, 17 canceled) vs. prior week's −16 (24 new, 40 canceled) — churn compression (40→17 cancellations) drives turnaround. August's −0.9/day MTD drag still trails +0.9/day YTD baseline but gap narrows. Thursday's 10 new subscribers matches highest single-day count since late July. Pattern suggests late-week recovery stabilizing after mid-month turbulence — need sustained acquisition above 4-5 daily to restore positive trajectory, but momentum shift evident.
